digest.component_or_area: production code complexity gate, lint infrastructure
propositions: Add shrink-only complexity baseline wrapper that accepts only Ruff C901 findings at or below recorded per-function ceilings, rejecting new debt and increases while allowing stale entries to be removed via guarded --update-stale.

Establish repository gate via python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check integrated into make lint, comparing current C901 diagnostics against committed .github/complexity-baseline.json with counters active/new/increased/stale; exit zero only when new=0, increased=0, and no scanner/schema error.

Define production-only complexity scope as src/rebar (separate from existing src/tests lint scope) with max-complexity threshold 15 pinned in pyproject.toml and baseline schema requiring AST-qualified symbol identity keys (e.g., src/rebar/example.py::Class.method) with integer ceilings >15.

Implement baseline JSON schema with schema_version 1, symbol-keyed ceilings dict supporting only FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef identities, rejection of unknown/duplicate/unsorted/malformed entries, and atomic persistence via rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write to prevent partial writes on failure.
